sourceRelease: Natural Earth v5.1.2; generalized cartographic roads, not a current routable road inventory
roadCostModel: Road geometry between cell-visit midpoints plus straight connectors to one quantized road anchor per cell, at the road's assumed class speed; origin/overland access at 25 km/h; road times rounded up to 0.1 second
shoreModel: Representatives on retained generalized land in mixed cells; bidirectional 25 km/h shore links along continuous land; input access follows land or explicit retained road-visit geometry at 25 km/h; v2 road anchors, road times, land mask and speeds unchanged
attachmentModel: Input-cell source visit owning the unchanged road anchor; local access to checked land points at 25 km/h plus quantized source-polyline distance to the anchor at its existing road class speed, rounded up to 0.1 second; v3 graph and legacy shore access unchanged
